data.narrative:
Multiply Labs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Fred Parietti and Alice Melocchi. The company has raised $41M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

A single method proved applicable to this analysis. Stage-Progression anchored on the company's $85M total-raised proxy as a baseline, applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage advancement. This approach yielded an implied valuation of $170M. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Multiply Labs' revenue is not publicly disclosed, and the Biotech & Health sector median P/S of 8.1x cannot be meaningfully deployed without that figure. Peer-Median triangulation was rejected due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable datapoints; only 1 adjacent-stage peer was identified within the narrow filters, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum for robust cross-sectional analysis.

The triangulated valuation range is $144.5M (low) to $195.5M (high), with a median of $170M. Given reliance on a single method, the analysis carries material uncertainty around stage-progression assumptions and the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific company. Obtaining revenue guidance or identifying additional near-stage private comps would strengthen conviction in this range.
